title: Zul'Rasaz tribe
wikitext:
The '''Zul'Rasaz tribe''',<ref name="new locations">[https://web.archive.org/web/20260514170802/https://turtlecraft.gg/new-locations-and-maps New Zones & World Edits]. Archived from [https://turtlecraft.gg/new-locations-and-maps the original] on 2026-05-14. Retrieved on 2026-29-08.</ref> also referred to as the '''Wildtusk''',<ref>[[Shadow Hunter Yin'do#Quotes]]</ref> are a tribe of [[forest troll]]s that inhabit the mountains between [[Arathi Highlands]] and the [[Hinterlands]], formerly inhabiting the troll city of [[Ruins of Zul'Rasaz|Zul'Rasaz]]. After the Amani empire was broken, the people of Zul'Rasaz fled into the mountains where they flourished for generations, maintaining a positive relationship with the local elementals and nurturing their growth. However, one of their own, [[Speaker Gan'to]], had fallen to the corruption of the Witherbark's lust for power.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|36|The Speaker's Betrayal}}</ref> The Zul'Rasaz tribe was razed and the survivors rebuilt a home in [[Wildtusk Village]],<ref name="new locations" /> eventually allying with the [[Horde]] for revenge against the traitor and the Witherbark.
